policy.name: KL Restrained Search Teacher v1 / Normal
policy.description: A short rollout can favor actions that exploit its simulated opponent rather than the real opponent. Restricting the search-induced change in move probabilities toward the native move policy may generalize better. kl-restrained
policy.model: Unchanged Context Teacher v1 guarded student and eight-world masked sampler; frozen native-score root-selection settings.
policy.information_model: Own army and public history only; no diagnostic truth, learned beliefs or information bonuses.

policy.name: Context Rollout Teacher v1 / Normal
policy.description: Eight-world four-ply masked rollout using the guarded student, retaining public root goals, quiet history and piece identities; simulated public events update memory.
